digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions mirror CI for main branch
propositions: Cancelled GitHub Actions runs on main render as red X on healthy commits due to concurrency-group superseding, making main appear broken when it is not

Scheduled-only main CI (every 6 hours, not on push) removes cancellations by construction, matching comparable Gerrit-primary projects (Go, OpenStack, LibreOffice) that surface no per-commit checks on mirrors

The main-health-report job must resolve the last-known-green main SHA from Actions API and emit a copy-pasteable git bisect recipe to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY on failure, with graceful degradation if the lookup fails
Non-main branch push CI and pre-merge Gerrit Verified gating are preserved unchanged; only the mirror's post-merge safety-net cadence is altered from per-commit to scheduled
